ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, points D and E are the midpoints of AB and AC, respectively. What is the ratio of $S_{\triangle ADE}$ to $S_{\text{quadrilateral} BCED}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since points D and E are the midpoints of AB and AC respectively,\\
it follows that DE$\parallel$BC,\\
which implies $\triangle ADE \sim \triangle ABC$,\\
thus, DE$\colon$ BC=1$\colon$ 2,\\
leading to $S_{\triangle ADE}\colon S_{\triangle ABC}=1\colon 4$,\\
hence, $S_{\triangle ADE}\colon S_{\text{quadrilateral} BCED}=1\colon 3$.\\
Therefore, the answer is: $S_{\triangle ADE} \colon S_{\text{quadrilateral} BCED}=\boxed{1\colon 3}$.

Therefore S_{△ADE}:S_{BCED}=1:3.
